lineage_policy: explicit model revisions, aliases, and parent IDs; cycles and unresolved parents fail closed
heldout_policy: transitive ancestry closures may not overlap train and held-out model sets
adaptation_policy: adaptable decisions require explicit caller permission
model_card_policy: serialized compatibility decisions are retained with surgeon evaluation cards
claim_boundary: No inference compatibility claim when required evidence is missing, unsupported, or incompatible.
